rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2018).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2018 as 'Oudtshoorn Joy'.
rows.Bloom: Vermilion. up to 60 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), rosette bloom form.
